aisha: Heads-up — noticing a regression on staging after flipping the prefill/decode phase split flag. p95 token latency up ~17-18% for small requests. I uploaded a flamegraph + KV logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/artifacts/1234 :thinking_face:

jonah: When did the split land? any config diffs besides the scheduler toggle?

aisha: landed at 2026-03-19T11:58 (deploy 2026.03.19.58). Config changes: phase_split: true, batcher.pool=staggered, kernel_hint removed (we used to force fast_gemm). Quick numbers from staging perf run:
- before: p50=34ms p95=120ms
- after:  p50=38ms p95=140ms
Token budget target was 48, batch size distribution shifted: mode went from 8->4 for prefill microbatches.

wei: grabbing logs now. seeing repeated KV evictions / warmups around the same window. grep snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T12:03:01Z] KVCache miss client=svc-frontend key=ctx-... warmup=false
[2026-03-19T12:03:01Z] KVCache insert key=ctx-... size=18KB
[2026-03-19T12:03:02Z] Kernel select: small_matmul path (latency + overhead)
```

perf-bot: ALERT: staging/regression/1730004 — p95 increased 17% vs baseline (last 24h). See dashboard: https://dash.redwood/perf/regressions/1730004 :warning:

jonah: hypothesis: splitting prefill->decode changed microbatch shape distribution; smaller prefill batches are triggering small-matmul kernels which have higher per-batch overhead and worse KV cache locality. Two quick mitigations to try:
1) nudge prefill_min_batch down/up? (we want fewer tiny prefill batches)
2) raise decode_token_budget to encourage larger decode batches
3) re-enable kernel_hint for that cohort while we stabilize

jonah: sample config to try in canary:
```
scheduling:
  prefill_min_batch: 6    # bump from 2 -> 6 to avoid tiny microbatches
  decode_token_budget: 64
  kernel_affinity: prefer_fast_gemm
```

aisha: will run an A/B canary with those three tweaks. running: `run_perf --canary --cases prefill_min_batch=6,decode_token_budget=64,kernel_affinity=prefer_fast_gemm` and will attach KV+batch-shape histograms. @wei can you collect kv-hit-rate and eviction-rate during the run? :thumbsup:

wei: yep. I'll snapshot `kv.hit_rate`, `kv.evictions`, and `batch.shape_histogram` every 30s and dump to /tmp/kv-shot-1730004.tar.gz. Also will watch for sudden kernel-choice spikes.

jonah: also add a small telemetry probe to count "small_matmul_invocations" and batch_shape percentiles (p10/p50/p90). that's cheap but will help confirm.

aisha: good call. adding the probe and kicking off the canary now. will report back with flamegraphs and kv metrics in ~20m. :rocket:
